from PIL import Image, ImageChops
img1=Image.open('/workspace/.tmp/agent_shots/seek_during.png').convert('RGB')
img2=Image.open('/workspace/.tmp/agent_shots/seek_post.png').convert('RGB')
d=ImageChops.difference(img1,img2)
bbox=d.getbbox()
print('diff_bbox',bbox)
if bbox:
    # compute mean diff
    import numpy as np
    arr=np.array(d)
    print('mean_diff',arr.mean())
PY
